listing.name: Tomb Raider I-III / TRX (LostArtefacts)
listing.summary: Prepare Tomb Raider I–III with the upstream combined TRX Windows ZIP and your own original game files.

steps.title: Extract the complete combined Windows player
steps.instruction: Download the official combined TRX Windows ZIP and extract it into a new, separate folder. Keep TRX.exe beside cfg/, games/, modules/ and scripts/. The inspected 1.12 package contains a 32-bit Windows executable; the Windows x64 host label does not make it an x64 binary. If using an upstream combined installer supplied separately, let that installer arrange the chosen game packs instead.

steps.title: Copy the corresponding original files
steps.instruction: Use your own corresponding Tomb Raider I, II or III files from Steam, GOG or disc. Follow the linked combined guide: TR1 data/*.phd goes into games/tr1/levels/, with fmv/ and music/ under games/tr1/. TR2 data/*.tr2 goes into games/tr2/levels/, main.sfx into games/tr2/, and fmv/ and music/ into their matching subfolders. TR3 data/*.tr2 goes into games/tr3/levels/, main.sfx into games/tr3/, audio/cdaudio.wad into games/tr3/audio/, cuts/*.tr2 into games/tr3/cuts/, and fmv/ into games/tr3/fmv/. Extract a purchased disc image first when needed; do not put these originals in top-level data/, fmv/, music/, audio/ or cuts/. Expansion packs have separate mappings in the guide.

steps.title: Choose the prepared player and game
steps.instruction: Finish setup with TRX.exe and its containing folder after preparing your chosen game. With no arguments, TRX opens the last selected game or expansion. To select a base game explicitly, enter two separate argument lines in Portcove: --mod on the first line, then tr1, tr2 or tr3 on the second. The engine download alone does not prepare the commercial originals.

steps.title: Preserve the prepared copy before updating
steps.instruction: Close TRX and back up the prepared folder, including originals, cfg/, saves/ and screenshots/, plus any locations selected through TRX_DIR, TRX_CONFIG_DIR, TRX_CACHE_DIR, TRX_GAMES_DIR, TRX_SAVES_DIR or TRX_SCREENSHOTS_DIR. You or upstream own updates and all these files; Portcove registration does not manage replacement or provide backups. For an older layout, prepare a fresh folder and follow the upstream migration guide before changing the registration. Mixing old cfg/<game-id>/ and top-level original trees with games/<game-id>/ is refused by TRX; keep the old copy intact until the replacement is ready.

warnings: Each original game and expansion keeps its own data requirements. The engine package does not supply ownership of commercial game data.
TR4 work is experimental upstream and is outside this Tomb Raider I–III setup claim.
